resources.string: Anti-Scroll needs Android usage access to measure scrolling applications. This access is read-only and all observations stay on this device.
Android allows Anti-Scroll to read usage history. The status is checked again whenever the application resumes.
Grant access in Android settings so Anti-Scroll can reconstruct application usage. Opening settings alone does not count as approval.
This device does not expose the expected usage-access service. Observation cannot start until Android provides it.
Anti-Scroll could not read the current system state. You can review the setting and return to try again.
Android could not open the usage-access settings screen on this device.
A minimal accessibility experiment may later improve detection speed. It is not implemented in this increment and usage-history collection will not depend on it.
Select the installed scrolling applications Anti-Scroll should observe. Your choices are stored only on this device.
No supported scrolling applications are currently installed on this device.
Anti-Scroll could not read the supported applications installed on this device.
The latest selection could not be saved. The previous configuration was restored.
